purpose: Research-only military competence fixtures; setup may inject a controlled authoritative state, but every controller order must use Engine.applyAction.
sourceRule: No gameplay or live-AI files are modified by these fixtures.

scenarios.setup: Two capitals on a compact Pangaea; Forge attacker has engineering/tactics, one catapult and three melee units; Iron defender has a walled capital and one defender; target is visible and reachable.
scenarios.objective: Reduce wallHP with siege, preserve the catapult, then capture with melee after walls fall.
passCriteria: siege is recruited only when affordable
no melee suicide into intact walls when a legal siege action exists
capture follows a valid wall-breach path

scenarios.setup: The same controlled wartime layout, but the visible enemy city starts with wallHP zero and no walls; Forge attacker has a catapult, swordsman and warrior adjacent to the city.
scenarios.objective: Positive control for the final legal melee capture and ownership-transfer step after the siege requirement has already been removed.
passCriteria: a validated attack can transfer the city
capture is distinguished from merely moving or city striking
no setup mutation is counted as an AI action

scenarios.setup: Controlled visible wartime state with three catapults, two swordsmen and one warrior adjacent to a 100-wall-HP enemy city; one defender remains. All units are ordinary content units and every order is still validated by the live action engine.
scenarios.objective: Test whether a reasonable multi-siege force can breach and capture a fortified city when siege attacks are actually selected.
passCriteria: wallHP reaches zero through legal siege actions
the city can then transfer by a legal melee capture
defensive city strikes and unit losses are recorded separately

scenarios.setup: Forge walled capital with a warrior and city-strike capability; opposing Iron force approaches through visible land with two melee units; no hostile mobs.
scenarios.objective: Prioritize capital defense, city strike or safe attack, and retreat damaged units instead of abandoning the capital.
passCriteria: capital remains owned through the defense horizon
damaged units seek safe owned territory
attacks are forecast/legal and do not knowingly sacrifice the last defender

scenarios.setup: Forge has one city, a settler and one escort on a legal expansion corridor; an opposing raider is visible but not yet adjacent; settlement tile is valid and outside the spacing rule.
scenarios.objective: Attach/maintain an escort, move the settler through the corridor, and found before capture.
passCriteria: escort is attached through a validated action
settler does not take an avoidable exposed route
founding succeeds or an explicit threat-driven retreat is recorded

fullGameComparison.baseline: Live Systems.aiTurn through ActorLifecycle.pump with conquest policy
fullGameComparison.replacement: Observation-only research controller using actual Engine.applyAction, real production/research costs and the same opponent
